elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 7.7 states that Customer is not liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under the Agreement or any Order Form.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount exists under the rendered clause, so the condition for this restriction is absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause permits no early-termination fee or other liquidated amount; zero liability is more protective than a three-month cap.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: Customer owes no liquidated amount at all, so there can be no additional liquidated amount beyond an early-termination fee.
